high_agreement.title: True Positive (High Agreement, IoU = 0.98)
high_agreement.subtitle: Both detectors capture the spindle with nearly identical onset and offset.

boundary_diff.title: Boundary Discrepancy (Matched, IoU = 0.60)
boundary_diff.subtitle: YASA's soft-thresholding extends or trims boundaries compared to hard Hilbert thresholding.

custom_only.title: Custom-Only Detection (Unmatched by YASA)
custom_only.subtitle: Crosses the 1.5 SD Hilbert envelope threshold for >0.5s, but fails YASA's multi-feature (rel_pow / corr) criteria.

yasa_only.title: YASA-Only Detection (Missed by Custom)
yasa_only.subtitle: Strong relative sigma power and covariance detected by YASA, or Custom stay above hard threshold was <0.5s.

stage_level.baseline: clean N2 baseline for Custom; clean sleep (N1–N4, REM) for YASA
